title: Not intended for a pool
text: Not intended for a pool. We resurfaced out gunite pool last summer with epoxy paint the the finish was slick.  We were looking for a non-slip solution for the walk-in steps.  Read all the reviews.  This stated it would work in a pool and there was a 5 star for use in a hot tub.  After less than two weeks, half of the pads have come off.  Might work great in a bathtub, but certainly would not recommend for an in-ground pool.
